description: This is a wall-mounted shelf unit with a rustic industrial design. It features a sturdy wooden shelf supported by black metal pipes, creating a simple yet functional aesthetic. Below the main shelf, there is a rack made of similar black pipes, designed to hang clothes hangers. Two wooden hangers are already attached to this rack. A vibrant red pot is placed on the top shelf, adding a pop of color to the otherwise neutral palette. The overall construction suggests durability and a utilitarian purpose, suitable for organizing or displaying items.
